papers.title: ReGround-Surg: Reliability-Guided Anchor Grounding for Referring Surgical Video Segmentation
papers.authors: Jiaxin Wen, Ming Yin, Lu Liu, Zeyu Fu
papers.tags: video segmentation, visual grounding, Segment Anything, semantic segmentation
papers.affiliations: University of Exeter, Exeter, UK
papers.intro: 本文提出ReGround-Surg，一种轻量级可靠性引导的锚定接地框架，通过预测文本条件空间可靠性图并复用于门控侧适配器和可靠性加权V2T注意力模块，显著提升SAM2-based Referring Surgical Video Segmentation的初始锚定质量，从而改善整体分割性能。

papers.title: X-MULTI: VLM-based Imaging Factor Disentanglement for Factor-Aware Image Synthesis
papers.authors: Sonali Godavarthy, Matthias Neuwirth-Trapp, Tim-Felix Faasch, Maarten Bieshaar, Michael Moeller, Kristof Van Laerhoven, Danda Pani Paudel
papers.tags: image generation, diffusion model, autonomous driving
papers.affiliations: University of Siegen, ETH Zürich, Bosch Research, INSAIT, Sofia University "St. Kliment Ohridski"
papers.intro: 本文提出X-MULTI方法，利用预训练视觉语言模型（VLM）对训练中合成的新颖因子组合进行零样本监督，并提出改进的I-FAA评估指标，通过因子特定增强和类平衡采样减少跨因子相关性泄漏，从而提升成像因子解耦的质量和评估的可靠性。

papers.title: Hierarchical Prototype-Memory Adaptation of SAM for Surgical Instrument Segmentation
papers.authors: Xinning Yao, Jingjing Wang, Jinghua Yue, Xiaoyan Luo, Fugen Zhou, Bo Liu
papers.tags: semantic segmentation, Segment Anything, medical image, vision transformer
papers.affiliations: Image Processing Center, Beihang University, Beijing, 100191, China
papers.intro: 本文提出HPMA框架，通过构建冻结的多尺度原型记忆库并设计层级表示级别到模块的耦合机制，将SAM适配到手术器械分割任务，在EndoVis2017和EndoVis2018数据集上取得了最先进的性能。

papers.title: It depends: Incorporating correlations for joint aleatoric and epistemic uncertainties of high-dimensional output spaces
papers.authors: Leonhard F. Feiner, Manuel Nickel, Martin Menten, Laurin Lux, Rickmer Braren, Daniel Rueckert, Georgios Kaissis, Raphael Rehms, Johannes Paetzold
papers.tags: depth estimation, image generation
papers.affiliations: Technical University of Munich, University Medical Center Hamburg-Eppendorf, Munich Center for Machine Learning (MCML), Weill Cornell Medicine, German Cancer Consortium (DKTK), Imperial College London, Hasso Plattner Institute for Digital Engineering, Cornell University
papers.intro: 本文提出一种基于低秩加对角（LR+D）协方差参数化的方法，将aleatoric和epistemic不确定性高效地联合建模为统一的二阶分布，在高维输出空间中捕获输出相关性，并在图像修复、着色、光流和深度估计任务上取得优于现有方法的不确定性量化性能。

papers.title: DoublesEval: Diagnosing Multi-Agent Tactical Reasoning in Vision-Language Models via Professional Doubles Badminton
papers.authors: Jintao Cheng, Weibin Li
papers.tags: multimodal learning, video segmentation, tracking, scene understanding
papers.affiliations: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology; University of Macau
papers.intro: 本文提出了DoublesEval，一个基于职业双打羽毛球视频的诊断性评估框架，通过四个可解释的推理维度系统性地诊断视觉语言模型在多智能体战术推理中的能力缺陷，并提出了TacticCheck这一轻量级测试时一致性检查器来缓解这些缺陷。

papers.title: Vision Language Model Fusion for Explainable Face Recognition
papers.authors: Ana Estrada-Real, Lydia Alapatt, Christoph Busch, Christian Rathgeb
papers.tags: multimodal learning, image classification
papers.affiliations: da/sec Biometrics and Security Research Group, Hochschule Darmstadt, Germany
papers.intro: 本文提出了一种多VLM融合框架，通过两个源VLM提供相似度分数和文本解释，再由第三个VLM作为决策模型综合多模态信息进行最终判断，在提升人脸识别准确率的同时生成更丰富、更鲁棒的解释。

papers.title: Markerless Pose Estimation for Resistance Training Technique Assessment
papers.authors: Joseph Turner, Jeff Clark, Nawid Keshtmand
papers.tags: pose estimation, video segmentation, autonomous driving, depth estimation, video search
papers.affiliations: School of Engineering Mathematics and Technology, University of Bristol, UK
papers.intro: 本文提出并评估了一个基于BlazePose无标记姿态估计的框架，从普通视频中提取深蹲、卧推和硬拉动作的关节角度轨迹，通过与参考重复动作的RMSE对比实现抗阻训练技术的定量评估，并系统研究了摄像机视角和遮挡对关节角度估计的影响。

papers.title: Variance-Guided Spatial Attention Fusion for Robust End-to-End Driving under Asymmetric Sensor Degradation
papers.authors: Weizhi Tao, Zengwang Jin, Xiao Wang, Hailong Huang
papers.tags: autonomous driving, BEV perception, LiDAR, multimodal learning, scene understanding
papers.affiliations: The Hong Kong Polytechnic University; Anhui University; Shenzhen Research Institute of Northwestern Polytechnical University
papers.intro: 本文提出VG-SAF框架，将异方差逐像素预测方差从下游诊断信号提升为多模态融合注意力的结构性输入，通过物理故障注入增强器提供稠密可靠性监督，并利用校准后的方差图驱动局部空间门控与跨模态信任软注意力，从而在非对称传感器退化下实现鲁棒的端到端驾驶。

papers.title: EG-ARSA: An Expert-Grounded Open Model for Visual Road Safety Auditing in Low-Resource Settings
papers.authors: Md Thamed Bin Zaman Chowdhury, Moazzem Hossain
papers.tags: multimodal learning, scene understanding, image classification
papers.affiliations: Department of Civil Engineering, Bangladesh University of Engineering and Technology (BUET), Dhaka, Bangladesh
papers.intro: 本文提出专家接地蒸馏（EGD）框架，通过将权威机构现场审计的专业知识校准并蒸馏到紧凑的8B参数视觉语言模型中，构建了首个面向孟加拉国农村/郊区道路的开放视觉安全审计模型EG-ARSA，在低资源环境下以远低于正式审计的成本实现了可扩展的道路安全审计，并发布了首个专家接地的孟加拉国道路安全审计数据集BD…

papers.title: FixAnything: 3D-Consistent Rendering Refinement via Video Generative Priors
papers.authors: Khiem Vuong, Deva Ramanan, Srinivasa Narasimhan
papers.tags: video generation, 3D reconstruction, diffusion model
papers.affiliations: Carnegie Mellon University, USA
papers.intro: FixAnything通过最小化修改和轻量级微调，将预训练视频生成模型（Wan2.1）重新用于修复多种3D表示（3DGS、NeRF、网格、稀疏点云）的渲染伪影，利用掩码感知条件机制和基于相机位姿精度的直接偏好优化（DPO）实现3D一致的渲染精炼。

papers.title: Investigating Relational Reasoning in VLMs
papers.authors: Adhithya Laxman Ravi Shankar Geetha, Aulia Kharis Rakhmasari, Haleema Ramzan, Xander Yap
papers.tags: multimodal learning, visual question answering, scene understanding
papers.affiliations: ETH Zurich, Switzerland（Department of Computer Science）
papers.intro: 本文通过构建受控合成几何图形数据集，结合线性探针（Linear Probing）和掩码消融实验，系统揭示了Qwen3-VL-4B在关系推理中采用"真实视觉推理与语言捷径混合"的双过程策略，证明其视觉理解仅限于显式可观察信息，缺乏超越表象的推理能力。

papers.title: Action-Aligned Retrieval with Pairwise Multimodal Reranking for Text-Based Person Anomaly Search
papers.authors: Thanh-Khoi Nguyen, Thanh-Nhan Vo, Trong-Thuan Nguyen, Minh-Triet Tran
papers.tags: multimodal learning, image retrieval, visual grounding
papers.affiliations: University of Science, VNU-HCM, Vietnam; Vietnam National University, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
papers.intro: 本文提出ActPair，一个统一的三阶段粗到细框架，通过动作对齐的多任务表示学习、上下文接地查询改写与并行后期融合检索、以及基于pivot-promote策略的成对多模态重排序，弥合姿态-语义鸿沟，实现文本描述的人物异常行为搜索。

papers.title: SVD-Based Typicality Maps for Out-of-Distribution Detection in Vision Transformers
papers.authors: Aldo Sean Sartor, Leandro de Souza Rosa, Andriy Enttsel, Mauro Mangia, Riccardo Rovatti
papers.tags: vision transformer, image classification
papers.affiliations: DEI, ARCES, University of Bologna, Italy
papers.intro: 本文提出一种基于SVD投影和类条件密度建模的典型性图（Typicality Maps）框架，通过分析ViT内部激活的几何结构，衍生出两种无需重训练和OOD数据暴露的后验OOD检测分数（PAS和MLSV），在ViT-B/16上取得了具有竞争力的检测性能。

papers.title: GeoWAM: Visual Geometry World Action Models for Autonomous Driving
papers.authors: Yiren Lu, Xin Ye, Jiaming Liu, Jin Yao, Yi-chung Chen, Liam Merino, Dhruva Dixith Kurra, Min Cai, Tom Lampo, Yu Yin, Danhua Guo, Burhan Yaman
papers.tags: autonomous driving, 3D reconstruction, point cloud, BEV perception
papers.affiliations: Uber AV Labs; Case Western Reserve University
papers.intro: GeoWAM提出了一种以视觉几何为核心的世界动作模型，通过预训练预测未来场景几何（点图）而非未来图像，并利用几何条件化的动作头预测自我轨迹，在开放环和闭环驾驶评估中显著优于基于图像的世界动作模型。

papers.title: Geometry-Driven Opti-Acoustic Co-Registration and View-Invariant Reflectivity Mapping for Side-Scan Sonar
papers.authors: Taqi Hamoda, Nuno Gracias
papers.tags: 3D reconstruction, image generation, scene understanding, autonomous driving
papers.affiliations: Computer Vision and Robotics Research Institute (ViCOROB), University of Girona, Spain
papers.intro: 本文提出一种基于几何驱动和物理信息引导的框架，利用Structure-from-Motion重建的3D海底网格作为几何锚点，结合First Bottom Return动态高度校正和逆Lambertian反射模型，实现侧扫声呐与光学图像的像素级精确配准及视角无关的海底反射率映射。

papers.title: What's the Catch? Evaluating Temporal Consistency in Vision-Language Models
papers.authors: Marek Hradil, Danae Sánchez Villegas
papers.tags: multimodal learning, video segmentation, scene understanding, video generation
papers.affiliations: University of Copenhagen
papers.intro: 论文提出TimeCatch基准，通过时间异常（交换相邻帧）和帧级异常（高斯噪声替换帧）的检测与定位任务，系统评估了五个开源VLM的时间一致性推理能力，发现模型在帧级异常任务上表现优异但在时间异常任务上接近随机水平，而人类在这两类任务上均接近满分，揭示了当前VLM在跨帧时间推理方面的根本性缺陷。

papers.title: Towards Comprehensive Basketball Understanding
papers.authors: Yirong Hu, Jiayuan Rao, Yu Zhang, Shangzhe Di, Weidi Xie
papers.tags: multimodal learning, video segmentation, tracking, scene understanding
papers.affiliations: 北京大学数学科学学院；上海交通大学人工智能学院
papers.intro: 本文提出了BasketballBench——一个包含7,980个问题、覆盖10项任务的综合性多模态篮球理解基准，并提出了BasketballSkills——一个将8个篮球专用感知与检索工具组织为4个可复用技能的分层智能体框架，实验证明该框架在10项任务中的8项上超越了最强的商业多模态大语言模型。

papers.title: Image-Conditioned Diffusion Models for Quality Assurance of Organ-at-Risk Segmentations in Radiotherapy
papers.authors: Clea Dronne, Catharine H Clark, Xavier Loizeau, Elizabeth Miles, Peter Hoskin, Jamie R McClelland
papers.tags: diffusion model, medical image, image generation, semantic segmentation
papers.affiliations: University College London; National Physical Laboratory; Mount Vernon Hospital; University of Manchester
papers.intro: 本文提出一种图像条件分割扩散模型用于放射治疗中OAR分割的QA，通过与VAE基线对比，证明该模型在检测和定位模拟分割边界错误方面更一致、更准确，尤其在细微错误定位上表现更优。

papers.title: OmniAssistBench: Assistant-style Interaction Benchmark for Omni-LLMs
papers.authors: Xianyun Sun, Chaoyou Fu, Zhengye Zhang, Feiyang Duan, Qingyuan Cao, Yonghui Niu, Sihang Yuan, Ge Zhang, Caifeng Shan
papers.tags: multimodal learning, video segmentation, visual grounding, scene understanding
papers.affiliations: Nanjing University, Nankai University, University of Waterloo
papers.intro: 本文提出了OmniAssistBench——一个面向全模态大语言模型的助手式交互基准，通过从现有互联网视频中逆向工程构建多轮交互数据集，并利用预定义先验知识固定交互路径，系统评估模型在基础感知和高级目标导向任务中的交互能力。

papers.title: Re$^3$Cap: Retrieval-Guided Refinement for Image Captioning Enhancement via Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Haonan Jia, Shichao Dong, Zenghui Sun, Jiawen Zheng, Ziqi Miao, Gege Shi, Qiuyu Zhao, Jinsong Lan, Xiaoyong Zhu, Bo Zheng
papers.tags: image captioning, multimodal learning, image retrieval
papers.affiliations: Taobao & Tmall Group of Alibaba; The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou); Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory
papers.intro: 本文提出Re$^3$Cap，一种基于多模态检索引导的强化学习推理策略，通过检索结果中的k-core子图分析来识别图像描述中的幻觉和遗漏，引导LVLMs生成更准确、更详细的图像描述，在无需额外标注的情况下超越监督微调的性能。
